decision: HOLD ACCEPTANCE pending a human-obtained copy of the 2022 TAG follow-up; Lean formalization AUTHORIZED in parallel
reasons: The counterexample is exact and independently confirmed (ebc-review-r1 gates A, B PASS).

The 2022 follow-up (Coronicova Hurajova, Madaras, Narayan, Theory Appl. Graphs 9(1) (2022) Art. 5, DOI 10.20429/tag.2022.090105; Zbl 1486.05071, 11 pp.) is unreadable by every permitted automated route (publisher and CORE behind Cloudflare challenges; Wayback 429), and a search snippet suggests it discusses a circulant conjecture; unlike the closed-access precedent (388087/324342) no description of its content is available to show it cannot subsume the counterexample.
Decision rule (ebc-review-r1 section 7): if the paper is silent on Classes 4, 7, 8, PROCEED to acceptance; if it already reports their failure or replaces the conjecture, EXCLUDE.
user_action_possible: the user can open the PDF in a browser (https://digitalcommons.georgiasouthern.edu/tag/vol9/iss1/5/) and place it in the T3 attachments directory; root will then read it
